description_en: Queries subdirectories and resources under a specified digital employee resource directory
description_zh: 查询指定数字员工资源目录下的子目录与资源
name: ListPersonalDirectoryContents

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. If not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数，缺省时使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the digital employee
parameters.name: operating_object_name

parameters.help_en: The page number. Default value: 1. Pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，默认值为1，从第1页开始
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The field by which the results are sorted. Valid values:

event_time: event creation time
event_execute_start_time: event execution time
event_execute_finish_time: event completion time
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果按照哪个字段排序，可选值如下：

event_time：事件创建时间
event_execute_start_time：事件执行时间
event_execute_finish_time：事件完成时间
parameters.name: sort_field

parameters.help_en: The sort order. This parameter takes effect when sortBy is specified. Valid values: ASC, DESC (case-insensitive)
parameters.help_zh: 指定排序顺序，sortBy填写时生效。可填值：ASC,DESC(大小写不敏感)
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: The list of service source types
parameters.name: source_types
